resolution.question: Will Prime Minister David Cameron appear in at least one televised set-piece event about the EU referendum before polling day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that David Cameron appeared in at least one televised set-piece event about the EU referendum before 23 June 2016 (polling day). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2016-06-20T22:00:00+01:00.
